title: Cohort Runway & Model Readiness Signal Playbook for Quarterly Hosted API Roadmap
creator: Sofia Chen
description: Create a playbook that maps quarterly roadmap lanes to customer cohorts and explicit model-readiness signals. The goal is to reduce last-minute rollbacks by giving engineering and ops a shared signal set (quality, cost, latency, capacity risk) that gates staged commitments and canaries for hosted API model rotations. This ties directly into OKRs for platform reliability and cost per token targets.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook document published and link shared with Eng/Design/Support
A matrix that maps 3 cohort types (PLG-small, Mid-market, Enterprise) to runway lanes and rollback thresholds

Defined list of 6 model-readiness signals (latency P50/P95, token-cost delta, regression eval pass rate, infra capacity buffer, error-rate trend, security/compliance checklist) with numeric thresholds
Canary schedule template that includes traffic % windows, duration, and automatic fallback policy
Runbook includes decision owners for each lane and a list of dependent tickets (ENG + infra)
updates: 2025-02-20: Initial outline reviewed with Platform Eng (Ethan Brooks). Feedback: add explicit capacity hedges for Dedicated spikes.
2025-02-25: Product/Design sync; Design suggested a compact dashboard tile for readiness signals to surface in Console.
2025-03-01: Eng requested decoupling of the latency threshold by region; added regional thresholds to draft.
2025-03-05: Leadership review scheduled; incorporated OKR mapping and final owner list. Assigned Marco as playbook owner.
risks: If thresholds are too strict, we delay model rollouts and miss Q2 commitments
If thresholds are too lenient, higher customer impact and potential SLA violations
Ownership gaps between Eng/Ops could slow canary rollback decisions
Regional capacity variability may require more sophisticated routing than documented
rollout_plan: Publish playbook during Q2 kickoff, run a tabletop exercise with Platform Eng and CS for two upcoming model rotations, instrument Console prototype widget, and iterate over one full canary window. After the trial, bake signal thresholds into automated gating for canaries and include in quarterly postmortem checklist.
